extracted.intended_audience: education researchers, grant administrators, librarians, institutional researchers, and policymakers interested in historical NSF awards
extracted.subtask_description: A bibliographic/catalog entry for a 1972 National Science Foundation grants-and-awards listing: a dataset-like document organized by topic and geography, with per-entry fields for researcher, institution, and award amount. The page documents the item metadata and available download/access formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization by topic area
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings of the National Science Foundation's grants and awards for 1972 are organized by topic areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The primary organizational hierarchy for the document is topical—group related grants under subject/topic headings to aid browsing and thematic discovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Within-topic listing by state geographical locations
rubrics_metrics.description: Within each topic area the entries are listed by state geographical locations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Within each topical grouping, entries are further ordered/segmented by U.S. state (geographical location) to facilitate regional lookup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry field: name(s) of researcher(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry contains the name(s) of the person(s) conducting the research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include full names of principal investigator(s)/project personnel as a discrete field for each grant entry to support attribution and search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry field: institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry contains the institution at which the research was conducted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record the institutional affiliation (college/university/organization) for each grant entry to allow institutional aggregation and filtering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry field: grant amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry contains the amount of the grant received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the award amount (currency and value) as a discrete data field for financial analysis and summary statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record-level bibliographic/metadata fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The page presents bibliographic metadata such as Publication date, Topics, Language, Item Size, Pages, Ppi, Identifier, and Identifier-ark.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include standard metadata (publication date, topical tags, language, file size, page count, image resolution/ppi, unique identifiers/ARK/ERIC number) to support citation, discovery, and archival management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide OCR/full-text extraction information
rubrics_metrics.description: Ocr: ABBYY FineReader 9.0 (the item has an OCR text layer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record which OCR engine/version was used and expose the OCRed full text to enable searchability and text-based processing; note OCR quality where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple download formats and accessibility support
rubrics_metrics.description: Download options include ABBYY GZ, FULL TEXT, EPUB, PDF, SINGLE PAGE PROCESSED JP2 ZIP, TORRENT, and a DAISY generation option for users with print-disabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide several machine- and human-readable formats (PDF, EPUB, full-text, image JP2), plus accessible formats (DAISY) and bulk download options to meet diverse user needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collection/classification tagging
rubrics_metrics.description: The item is assigned to collections: Education Resources Information Center (ERIC) Archive; US Government Mirrored Documents (Citizen Collection); Government Documents (Worldwide).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assign items to relevant repository collections and topical/administrative tags to improve discoverability and contextual placement within archival holdings.
